extracted.name: Roasted baby potatoes
extracted.description: Cook these mini roasties with garlic and rosemary. A longer roast makes them sweet and nutty, with a golden, crisp exterior
ingredient_lines: 1 garlic bulb halved through the equator
small bunch of rosemary needles picked and finely chopped
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Toss the baby potatoes with the olive oil, halved garlic bulb and rosemary in a roasting tin. Season. Roast for 50 mins-1 hr until the potatoes are tender and the skins golden brown and slightly wrinkled. Toss again before before serving.
